caption: The drawing depicts a circular plate or medallion with a yellowish background and a brown border. Within the circle, several abstract floral or leaf-like motifs with elongated, curved, brownish-red petals or leaves are arranged, each connected to thin, branched black stems. There are accents of green foliage scattered among the stems and flowers. In the center, the numbers "1832" are written in black, and beneath these numbers are the initials "J H". At the bottom of the composition, a small rectangular base, also outlined in green and brown, appears from which the stems originate. The background outside the circle is plain and off-white. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner inside the white border as "E. H. Shell. 3/25."
title: Pa. German Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
